milestone: P5b: complete Pasta dot_iter wrapper with explicit iterator, length and zip behavior
validation_method: Fresh direct public-method extraction through the exact reproduce.py block, byte-identical compiled models, incremental compilation of four new proof modules, complete strict census, and hashes of all unchanged baseline dependencies.
input_states: Both Pasta fields and all four production loose/reduced input pairs, subject to their representation bounds.
iterator_domain: Successful conversions and length calls; finite error-free traces; correct reported lengths and equal input lengths for the conventional dot-product contract. The actual zip callback must construct the two original iterator states. The standard default callback is instantiated and checked. A more general contract instead describes the actual zipped trace, including overrides. Unequal reported lengths, or unequal actual lengths under correct reports, execute the original panic branch.
postcondition: Valid loose output; decoded value equals the pairwise decoded product sum modulo the prime, or the decoded sum over the actual zipped trace for a custom zip override.

required_Lean_obligations: remainder frame through the paired loop

translation_trust_boundary: Pinned Charon/Aeneas and the previously checked product adapters. A checked Rust Iterator-item coherence projection removes two redundant lifted variables and changes only their 37 type annotations. A separate checked dictionary projection retains both actual Iterator supertrait dictionaries, both dispatched len methods and the left dispatched zip method in an ExactIteratorOps record, without assuming default bodies. Arithmetic and control flow remain byte-identical; both checkers reject five mutations. The generated unused default-len template is not called; no implementation or axiom is supplied for it. Kernel-checked function equalities reuse the complete pair-iterator proof. These projections are audited translation-boundary components, not verified compiler passes.
remaining_obligations: V3 final scope documentation and final local commit.
